title: Support copilot that acts: a sidecar issues the credit the rep offers, under a cap enforced in code
alias: agent assist with scoped tool execution
summary: A support copilot demo built to show an ai_sidecar executing scoped tools on a call it does not own. The cap, the caller binding and the one-credit-per-order rule live in the handler, and every refusal reads the same to the model.
scenario: A customer talks to a human rep while a sidecar looks up the order and issues the credit the rep promised, or refuses and says why on the rep's screen
